title: Network Participation Agreements — Additional Plan Runs for Long-Standing Agreements
content:
**Tenure addition.** A long-standing agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements** is given more claim payment runs over which to repay a repayment plan. The plan tenure addition to the plan run count is set by the whole months from the agreement's effective date to today:

- 96 months or more adds 6 runs;
- 48 months or more but fewer than 96 adds 3 runs;
- fewer than 48 months adds nothing.

## Counting whole months

Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the effective date shown on the agreement record and today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the effective date's day of the month.

## Band table

| Whole months in force | Runs added |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 48 | None |
| 48 to 95 | 3 |
| 96 or more | 6 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Effective 5 October, year 1; today 5 October, year 9: 96 months, so 6 runs.
- Effective 6 October, year 1; today 5 October, year 9: 95 months, so 3 runs.
